description: Loads an indexed transaction, uses its sender as the bounded graph root, returns sender/recipient trace roots plus the graph and an explicit edge to highlight. Useful for following native XGR transaction relations, but it does not attribute later mixed balances to the seed value.

fromTimestamp.description: Value for the from timestamp parameter.

maxEdges.description: Value for the max edges parameter.

maxNodes.description: Value for the max nodes parameter.

minValueWei.description: Value for the min value wei parameter.

toTimestamp.description: Value for the to timestamp parameter.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed transaction hash to inspect or resolve.

name: trace_xgr_transaction

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Trace an XGR transaction relation graph
